opening: Give your opening public account of the policy-selection process. If you are the policy maker, say why you enacted the resulting policy. If you are the round manager, explain what you drew and passed, and respond to the policy maker's account if useful. You can choose what to disclose or claim. Your private observations below are the actual cards, not a script you must repeat publicly.
reaction: Give your initial reaction to the representatives' opening accounts. You may ask a representative a specific question, challenge an account, defend a player, or offer a theory about trust and team membership.
round-robin: Respond to the latest visible discussion if you wish. If you are one of the representatives, use this opportunity to address questions and accusations about your policy choices. React to what players have actually said; you do not need to repeat your opening account or invent a disagreement. You may pass by returning an empty string if you have nothing useful to add.
